findings.issue: It is twice as long does not necessarily mean its length has doubled; the first can compare different objects and the second compares an object with its earlier state.
findings.recommended_action: Make the before/after referent explicit, or have an editor approve It is twice as long as before. Do not draw two unrelated ropes and call that doubling.

CD-0131.example: This strip is twice as long as that strip. To put it another way, two copies of that strip, placed end to end, would match this strip.
CD-0131.meaning: Introduces a different wording of the same idea.
CD-0131.original_source_example: It is twice as long. To put it another way, its length has doubled.
